# fptcloud_database_proxies (Data Source)

Lists the DB proxies of a FPT Cloud database cluster. The list has no `end_point` or `flavor`: the portal returns them only for one proxy, so use the resource `fptcloud_database_proxy` for them.

## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) The Id of the database cluster.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The Id of the database cluster.
- `proxies` (List of Object) DB proxies of the cluster. `id` is the Id to use with `fptcloud_database_proxy`; `node_count` is the number of nodes the proxy is made of (2 with high availability). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proxies))

<a id="nestedatt--proxies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `proxies`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String)
- `high_availability` (Boolean)
- `id` (String)
- `lb_type` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `node_count` (Number)
- `node_cpu` (Number)
- `node_ram` (Number)
- `status` (String)
- `storage_profile` (String)
- `vm_sync` (Boolean)

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fptcloud_database_proxies" "db" {
  cluster_id = fptcloud_database.db.id
}

output "proxy_names" {
  value = [for p in data.fptcloud_database_proxies.db.proxies : p.name]
}
```
